data.body: Kickoff continuation: isolated worktrees /Users/joeoakhart/impl-0303-a5 and /Users/joeoakhart/impl-0303-a6-0a, direct per-ticket Gerrit reviews to refs/for/main following recent merged history and the repository fallback for non-feature-branch drivers. A5 ADR 0060 is committed locally as b4d2d828; deterministic AC checks, lint, and typecheck pass, with a full -x suite rerun in progress after an unrelated earlier test error. A6-0a is claimed after a zero-blocker PASS; oracle source audit corrected the fsck signal from PUSH_PENDING to DIVERGED before test edits, and the execution-phase re-review is running.
